scale_policy: One authoring unit represents ten proposed game world units for consistent cross-ship detailing. Proposed lengths are explicit authoring recommendations, not recovered metres or existing game overrides. Final comparison uses a single shared camera/scale. Keep actual bounding-box and normalization metadata.
detail_policy: Lazzaro: readable cockpit, research equipment and four small pods. Delphini: reinforced hull, three visual weapon stations with uncalibrated attachment semantics. Messier: layered capsule, copper housings, distributed windows and four potential stations. Transportation: two substantial linked modules, cargo/service infrastructure and two possible stations. Window/maintenance feature size reflects unit class; avoid using the same enlarged cockpit on every hull.

budgets.material_strategy: One shared worn PBR atlas; distinct body panels and readable recesses, geometry batched by functional assembly.

integration: Exactly one canonical Blend/GLB per ship; replace superseded source/catalogue selections before PR completion; preserve historical evidence without distributing old model copies. Game progress/attachments/scale overrides require explicit main-thread integration and client acceptance.
